statement: The function returns a result res (it does not fail), and res is the maximum length of a non-empty contiguous subarray of nums that is product equivalent. For indices l and u with 0 <= l < u <= len(nums), define P(l,u) as the product of nums[i] for l <= i < u, G(l,u) as the greatest common divisor of the set {nums[i] | l <= i < u}, and M(l,u) as the least common multiple of that same set, all as positive mathematical integers. The subarray nums[l..u) is product equivalent iff P(l,u) = M(l,u) * G(l,u). Then res = max { u - l | 0 <= l < u <= len(nums) and P(l,u) = M(l,u) * G(l,u) }.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10.

statement: For every nums satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result res; it does not fail because of integer overflow, out-of-bounds indexing, or panic.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result res, res <= len(nums).
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result res, res >= 2.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result res, there exist indices l and u with 0 <= l < u <= len(nums) such that u - l = res and nums[l..u) is product equivalent, i.e. P(l,u) = M(l,u) * G(l,u) using the definitions from spec_1.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result res, for every pair of indices l and u with 0 <= l < u <= len(nums), if nums[l..u) is product equivalent (P(l,u) = M(l,u) * G(l,u) as in spec_1), then u - l <= res.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result res, res = len(nums) if and only if the whole array nums[0..len(nums)) is product equivalent.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result res, res = 2 if and only if there is no product-equivalent contiguous subarray of length at least 3.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result res, res = 2.
preconditions: len(nums) = 2; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result res, res = len(nums).
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] = 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result res, res = len(nums) if and only if for every pair of indices i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), gcd(nums[i], nums[j]) = 1.
preconditions: 3 <= len(nums) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10.

statement: For every nums satisfying the preconditions, if the function returns res on nums and returns res_rev on the reversed slice reverse(nums), where (reverse(nums))[i] = nums[len(nums)-1-i] for 0 <= i < len(nums), then res = res_rev.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result res, let W be the maximum length of a non-empty contiguous subarray nums[l..u) such that at most one index i with l <= i < u has nums[i] > 1. Then res >= max(2, W).
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result res, res <= 4.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 2 <= nums[i] <= 10.
